---
title: "Projects & Research Themes"
resources:
  - "projects/**"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/js-yaml/4.1.0/js-yaml.min.js"></script>
---

<style>
  /* --- GLOBAL CARD COLOR THEME --- */
  :root {
    --card-bg: #ffffff; 
    --card-border: #e0e6ed; 
    --text-main: #031C59; 
    --badge-role-bg: #5b626b;
    --badge-role-text: #ffffff;
    --badge-fund-text: #008BD2;
  }

  /* Dark Mode Sync */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --card-bg: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1);
    --card-border: #99ddff;
    --text-main: #f3f3f3;
    --badge-role-bg: #99ddff;
    --badge-role-text: #031C59;
    --badge-fund-text: #99ddff;
  }

  /* --- PROJECT GRID STYLES --- */
  .section-title {
    color: var(--text-main);
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: 3rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--card-border);
    padding-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .project-grid { 
    display: grid; 
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr)); 
    gap: 25px; 
  }

  .project-card {
    background: var(--card-bg); 
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border); 
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    cursor: pointer; 
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    display: flex; 
    flex-direction: column; 
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
  }
  
  .project-card:hover { 
    transform: translateY(-5px); 
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15); 
  }

  .project-title { 
    font-size: 1.15rem; 
    font-weight: 700; 
    color: var(--text-main); 
    margin-top: 0; 
    margin-bottom: 15px; 
    line-height: 1.3; 
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .project-badges {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  .badge-role {
    background: var(--badge-role-bg);
    color: var(--badge-role-text);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  .badge-fund {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    color: var(--badge-fund-text);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
  }

  .project-desc { 
    font-size: 0.95rem; 
    color: var(--bs-body-color); 
    margin: 0; 
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* --- DETAIL VIEW STYLES --- */
  .project-detail-container { 
    display: none; 
    animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease; 
    background: var(--card-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 40px;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
  
  .project-detail-container.active { display: block; }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .back-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    color: var(--text-main); padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 30px; transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  
  .back-btn:hover { background: rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.1); }
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .back-btn:hover, body.quarto-dark .back-btn:hover { background: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.2); }

  .detail-layout { display: flex; gap: 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  
  .detail-content { flex: 2 1 400px; color: var(--bs-body-color); }
  .detail-title { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-main); margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; line-height: 1.2; }
  
  .detail-img-container { flex: 1 1 300px; max-width: 450px; }
  .detail-img { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--card-border); }
  
  .detail-categories {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--badge-fund-text);
    font-style: italic;
    margin-top: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
</style>

:::: {style='margin-top: 3em;'}
::::

<!-- APP WRAPPER -->
<div id="project-app">

<!-- GRID VIEW -->
<div id="grid-view">
<h2 class="section-title">Ongoing Projects</h2>
<div id="ongoing-grid" class="project-grid"></div>

<h2 class="section-title" style="margin-top: 4rem;">Past Projects</h2>
<div id="past-grid" class="project-grid"></div>
</div>

<!-- DETAIL VIEW -->
<div id="detail-view" class="project-detail-container">
<button class="back-btn" onclick="closeProjectDetail()">{{< iconify fa-solid:arrow-left >}} &nbsp; Back to Projects</button>

<div class="detail-layout">
<div class="detail-content">
<h2 id="detail-title" class="detail-title"></h2>

<div class="project-badges" style="margin-bottom: 25px;">
<span id="detail-role" class="badge-role"></span>
<span id="detail-fund" class="badge-fund"></span>
</div>

<p id="detail-full-desc" style="text-align: justify; line-height: 1.7; font-size: 1.05rem;"></p>

<p class="detail-categories"><strong>Research Themes:</strong> <span id="detail-categories-text"></span></p>
</div>

<div class="detail-img-container" id="detail-img-wrapper">
<img id="detail-image" class="detail-img" src="" alt="Project Image">
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<!-- THE DATA FETCHER AND LOGIC -->
<script>
  let projectsData = [];

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    fetch('projects/projects.yml')
      .then(response => {
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`File not found (HTTP ${response.status})`);
        return response.text();
      })
      .then(yamlText => {
        try {
          projectsData = jsyaml.load(yamlText);
        } catch (e) {
          throw new Error("Your YAML file has a syntax error. Check your spaces and indents!");
        }
        
        if (projectsData && projectsData.length > 0) {
          renderProjectGrids();
        }
      })
      .catch(error => {
        console.error("Error loading projects:", error);
        document.getElementById('grid-view').innerHTML = `
          <div style="background: rgba(214, 101, 71, 0.1); border: 1px solid #D66547; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; color: #D66547;">
            <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">Error Loading Projects</h4>
            <p>${error.message}</p>
          </div>
        `;
      });
  });

  function renderProjectGrids() {
    const ongoingGrid = document.getElementById('ongoing-grid');
    const pastGrid = document.getElementById('past-grid');
    
    if (!ongoingGrid || !pastGrid) return;
    
    ongoingGrid.innerHTML = '';
    pastGrid.innerHTML = '';

    projectsData.forEach((project, index) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'project-card';
      card.onclick = () => openProjectDetail(index); 
      
      card.innerHTML = `
        <h3 class="project-title"><span>${project.emoji}</span> <span>${project.title}</span></h3>
        <div class="project-badges">
          <span class="badge-role">${project.role}</span>
          <span class="badge-fund">{{< iconify fa-solid:globe >}} ${project.funding}</span>
        </div>
        <p class="project-desc">${project.short_description}</p>
      `;
      
      if (project.status && project.status.toLowerCase() === 'ongoing') {
        ongoingGrid.appendChild(card);
      } else {
        pastGrid.appendChild(card);
      }
    });
  }

  function openProjectDetail(index) {
    const project = projectsData[index];
    
    document.getElementById('grid-view').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('detail-view').classList.add('active');
    
    document.getElementById('detail-title').innerHTML = `${project.emoji} ${project.title}`;
    document.getElementById('detail-role').innerText = project.role;
    document.getElementById('detail-fund').innerHTML = `{{< iconify fa-solid:globe >}} ${project.funding}`;
    
    // THIS IS THE CRUCIAL FIX (.innerHTML instead of .innerText)
    document.getElementById('detail-full-desc').innerHTML = project.full_description;
    
    document.getElementById('detail-categories-text').innerText = project.categories;
    
    const imgWrapper = document.getElementById('detail-img-wrapper');
    const imgEl = document.getElementById('detail-image');
    
    if (project.image && project.image.trim() !== '') {
      imgEl.src = project.image;
      imgWrapper.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      imgWrapper.style.display = 'none';
    }
    
    window.scrollTo({ top: document.getElementById('project-app').offsetTop - 50, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }

  function closeProjectDetail() {
    document.getElementById('detail-view').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('grid-view').style.display = 'block';
  }
</script>
